zh.title: Staging 和专业摄影：要不要做，要注意什么
zh.seo_title: Staging 与摄影：卖房展示指南｜陈靖
zh.description: Staging 和专业摄影要看房子情况决定。本文比较全屋、局部和虚拟 Staging 的差别，说明拍摄前的准备，以及自 2026 年起加州对经过数字修改的房源图片的披露要求。
zh.lead: 买方多半先在手机上看到你的房子。照片和房间摆设决定他们是否想来实地看，但展示必须如实反映房屋。

en.title: Staging and Photography: What to Decide Before Listing
en.seo_title: Staging and Listing Photos for Sellers | Jing Chen
en.description: Whether to stage depends on the home. Compare full, partial and virtual staging, photo prep, and California rules on digitally altered images.
en.lead: Most buyers meet your home on a phone screen first. Photos and furnishing decide whether they come to see it, and they have to represent the home accurately.
